title: त्रिंशत्तमोऽध्यायः

summary.en: Under Yudhishthira's rule the kingdom flourishes and his treasury overflows. With Krishna's encouragement he resolves on the sacrifice; Vyasa and the priests are appointed, Sahadeva arranges the materials, and Nakula is sent to invite Bhishma, Drona, Dhritarashtra and the Kauravas.
summary.kn: ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನ ಆಳ್ವಿಕೆಯಲ್ಲಿ ರಾಜ್ಯ ಸಮೃದ್ಧವಾಗಿ ಕೋಶ ತುಂಬಿ ತುಳುಕುತ್ತದೆ. ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನ ಪ್ರೋತ್ಸಾಹದಿಂದ ಯಜ್ಞಕ್ಕೆ ನಿಶ್ಚಯಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ವ್ಯಾಸರು ಮತ್ತು ಋತ್ವಿಜರು ನೇಮಕಗೊಳ್ಳುತ್ತಾರೆ, ಸಹದೇವನು ಸಾಮಗ್ರಿ ಸಿದ್ಧಪಡಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ, ಭೀಷ್ಮ, ದ್ರೋಣ, ಧೃತರಾಷ್ಟ್ರ, ಕೌರವರನ್ನು ಆಹ್ವಾನಿಸಲು ನಕುಲನನ್ನು ಕಳುಹಿಸಲಾಗುತ್ತದೆ.
summary.hi: युधिष्ठिर के शासन में राज्य समृद्ध होता है और कोष भर जाता है। श्रीकृष्ण के प्रोत्साहन से वे यज्ञ का निश्चय करते हैं; व्यास और ऋत्विज नियुक्त होते हैं, सहदेव सामग्री जुटाते हैं, और भीष्म, द्रोण, धृतराष्ट्र तथा कौरवों को बुलाने नकुल को भेजा जाता है।
summary.te: యుధిష్ఠిరుని పాలనలో రాజ్యం సమృద్ధి చెంది కోశాగారం నిండిపోతుంది. శ్రీకృష్ణుని ప్రోత్సాహంతో యజ్ఞానికి నిశ్చయిస్తాడు; వ్యాసుడు, ఋత్విక్కులు నియమితులవుతారు, సహదేవుడు సామగ్రి సమకూరుస్తాడు, భీష్ముడు, ద్రోణుడు, ధృతరాష్ట్రుడు, కౌరవులను ఆహ్వానించడానికి నకులుని పంపుతారు.
summary.ta: யுதிஷ்டிரரின் ஆட்சியில் நாடு செழித்துக் கருவூலம் நிரம்பி வழிகிறது. ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணரின் ஊக்கத்தால் அவர் யாகத்தைத் தீர்மானிக்கிறார்; வியாஸரும் ருத்விக்குகளும் நியமிக்கப்படுகிறார்கள், ஸஹதேவன் பொருள்களை ஏற்பாடு செய்கிறான், பீஷ்மர், துரோணர், திருதராஷ்டிரன், கௌரவர்களை அழைக்க நகுலன் அனுப்பப்படுகிறான்.
summary.ml: യുധിഷ്ഠിരന്റെ ഭരണത്തിൽ രാജ്യം അഭിവൃദ്ധിപ്പെടുന്നു, ഖജനാവ് നിറഞ്ഞൊഴുകുന്നു. കൃഷ്ണന്റെ പ്രോത്സാഹനത്താൽ അദ്ദേഹം യജ്ഞം നടത്താൻ തീരുമാനിക്കുന്നു; വ്യാസനെയും പുരോഹിതന്മാരെയും നിയമിക്കുന്നു, സഹദേവൻ സാധനങ്ങൾ ക്രമീകരിക്കുന്നു, ഭീഷ്മർ, ദ്രോണർ, ധൃതരാഷ്ട്രർ, കൗരവർ എന്നിവരെ ക്ഷണിക്കാൻ നകുലനെ അയയ്ക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.30; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
रक्षणाद्धर्मराजस्य सत्यस्य परिपालनात् ।
शत्रूणां क्षपणाच्चैव स्वकर्मनिरताः प्रजाः ॥

meaning.en: Because the king of dharma protected them, upheld truth and destroyed enemies, the people were devoted each to their own work.

verses.text:
बलीनां सम्यगादानाद्धर्मतश्चानुशासनात् ।
निकामवर्षी पर्जन्यः स्फीतो जनपदोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: By the proper collection of taxes and rule according to dharma, Parjanya rained as desired and the realm flourished.

verses.text:
सर्वारम्भाः सुप्रवृत्ता गोरक्षं कर्षणं वणिक् ।
विशेषात्सर्वमेवैतत्संजज्ञे राजकर्मणः ॥

meaning.en: All undertakings went well: cattle-keeping, farming and trade; all this arose especially from the king's governance.

verses.text:
दस्युभ्यो वञ्चकेभ्यो वा राजन्प्रति परस्परम् ।
राजवल्लभतश्चैव नाश्रूयन्त मृषा गिरः ॥

meaning.en: Among thieves or cheats, O king, or between people, or through the king's favourites, no false words were heard.

verses.text:
अवर्षं चातिवर्षं च व्याधिपावकमूर्छनम् ।
सर्वमेतत्तदा नासीद्धर्मनित्ये युधिष्ठिरे ॥

meaning.en: Drought, excessive rain, disease, fire and sudden calamity: none of it existed then, with Yudhishthira ever devoted to dharma.

verses.text:
प्रियं कर्तुमुपस्थातुं बलिकर्म स्वभावजम् ।
अभिहर्तुं नृपा जग्मुर्नान्यैः कार्यैः पृथक्पृथक् ॥

meaning.en: Kings went, each separately, to please him, to wait on him and to bring their natural tributes, for no other business.

verses.text:
धर्म्यैर्धनागमैस्तस्य ववृधे निचयो महान् ।
कर्तुं यस्य न शक्येत क्षयो वर्षशतैरपि ॥

meaning.en: By lawful income his hoard grew great, such that it could not be exhausted even in hundreds of years.

verses.text:
स्वकोशस्य परीमाणं कोष्ठस्य च महीपतिः ।
विज्ञाय राजा कौन्तेयो यज्ञायैव मनो दधे ॥

meaning.en: Knowing the measure of his treasury and storehouse, King Yudhishthira set his mind on a sacrifice.

verses.text:
सुहृदश्चैव तं सर्वे पृथक्च सह चाब्रुवन् ।
यज्ञकालस्तव विभो क्रियतामत्र सांप्रतम् ॥

meaning.en: All his friends, both singly and together, said to him: Lord, the time for the sacrifice has come; let it be performed now.

verses.text:
अथैवं ब्रुवतामेव तेषामभ्याययौ हरिः ।
ऋषिः पुराणो वेदात्मा दृश्यश्चापि विजानताम् ॥

meaning.en: While they were speaking thus, Hari arrived, the ancient sage, the soul of the Vedas, seen by those who know.

verses.text:
जगतस्तस्थुषां श्रेष्ठः प्रभवश्चाप्ययश्च ह ।
भूतभव्यभवन्नाथः केशवः केशिसूदनः ॥

meaning.en: He is the best of all that moves and stands, their origin and dissolution, lord of what was, is and will be: Keshava, slayer of Keshi.

verses.text:
प्राकारः सर्ववृष्णीनामापत्स्वभयदोऽरिहा ।
बलाधिकारे निक्षिप्य संहत्यानकदुन्दुभिम् ॥

meaning.en: The rampart of all the Vrishnis, giver of fearlessness in danger and destroyer of foes, he had left Anakadundubhi in charge of the army.

verses.text:
उच्चावचमुपादाय धर्मराजाय माधवः ।
धनौघं पुरुषव्याघ्रो बलेन महता वृतः ॥

meaning.en: Madhava, tiger among men, surrounded by a great force, brought for Yudhishthira a flood of wealth, of every sort, high and low.

verses.text:
तं धनौघमपर्यन्तं रत्नसागरमक्षयम् ।
नादयन्रथघोषेण प्रविवेश पुरोत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Making the earth resound with the noise of his chariot, he entered the best of cities with that boundless flood of wealth, an inexhaustible ocean of jewels.

verses.text:
असूर्यमिव सूर्येण निवातमिव वायुना ।
कृष्णेन समुपेतेन जहृषे भारतं पुरम् ॥

meaning.en: As a sunless place is gladdened by the sun, and a windless place by the wind, the city of the Bharatas rejoiced at Krishna's coming.

verses.text:
तं मुदाभिसमागम्य सत्कृत्य च यथाविधि ।
संपृष्ट्वा कुशलं चैव सुखासीनं युधिष्ठिरः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira joyfully met him, honoured him as is proper, and asked after his welfare as he sat at ease.

verses.text:
धौम्यद्वैपायनमुखैरृत्विग्भिः पुरुषर्षभः ।
भीमार्जुनयमैश्चापि सहितः कृष्णमब्रवीत् ॥

meaning.en: Then that best of men, with the priests led by Dhaumya and Dvaipayana, and with Bhima, Arjuna and the twins, spoke to Krishna.

verses.text:
त्वत्कृते पृथिवी सर्वा मद्वशे कृष्ण वर्तते ।
धनं च बहु वार्ष्णेय त्वत्प्रसादादुपार्जितम् ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said: Krishna, because of you the whole earth is in my power, and much wealth has been gained by your grace, Vrishni.

verses.text:
सोऽहमिच्छामि तत्सर्वं विधिवद्देवकीसुत ।
उपयोक्तुं द्विजाग्र्येषु हव्यवाहे च माधव ॥

meaning.en: So I wish, Devaki's son, to use all of it properly, on the best of brahmins and in the fire, Madhava.

verses.text:
तदहं यष्टुमिच्छामि दाशार्ह सहितस्त्वया ।
अनुजैश्च महाबाहो तन्मानुज्ञातुमर्हसि ॥

meaning.en: I wish to sacrifice with you, Dasharha, together with my brothers, mighty-armed one; please give me your leave.

verses.text:
स दीक्षापय गोविन्द त्वमात्मानं महाभुज ।
त्वयीष्टवति दाशार्ह विपाप्मा भविता ह्यहम् ॥

meaning.en: Govinda, mighty-armed, consecrate yourself for the sacrifice; when you have sacrificed, Dasharha, I shall be free of sin.

verses.text:
मां वाप्यभ्यनुजानीहि सहैभिरनुजैर्विभो ।
अनुज्ञातस्त्वया कृष्ण प्राप्नुयां क्रतुमुत्तमम् ॥

meaning.en: Or else give leave to me with these brothers, lord; with your permission, Krishna, I may obtain the supreme rite.

verses.text:
तं कृष्णः प्रत्युवाचेदं बहूक्त्वा गुणविस्तरम् ।
त्वमेव राजशार्दूल सम्राडर्हो महाक्रतुम् ।
संप्राप्नुहि त्वया प्राप्ते कृतकृत्यास्ततो वयम् ॥

meaning.en: Krishna answered him, after extolling at length his virtues: You alone, tiger among kings, are fit to be emperor and to perform the great rite. Once you have done it, we shall have fulfilled our aims too.

verses.text:
यजस्वाभीप्सितं यज्ञं मयि श्रेयस्यवस्थिते ।
नियुङ्क्ष्व चापि मां कृत्ये सर्वं कर्तास्मि ते वचः ॥

meaning.en: Perform the sacrifice you desire; with me standing by for your good, appoint me to any task, and I will do all you say.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
सफलः कृष्ण संकल्पः सिद्धिश्च नियता मम ।
यस्य मे त्वं हृषीकेश यथेप्सितमुपस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: My resolve has borne fruit, Krishna, and success is certain for me, since you, Hrishikesha, have come as I wished.

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
अनुज्ञातस्तु कृष्णेन पाण्डवो भ्रातृभिः सह ।
ईहितुं राजसूयाय साधनान्युपचक्रमे ॥

meaning.en: With Krishna's consent, the Pandava with his brothers began to prepare the means for the Rajasuya.

verses.text:
तत आज्ञापयामास पाण्डवोऽरिनिबर्हणः ।
सहदेवं युधां श्रेष्ठं मन्त्रिणश्चैव सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Then the Pandava, destroyer of foes, commanded Sahadeva, the best of warriors, and all his ministers:

verses.text:
अस्मिन्क्रतौ यथोक्तानि यज्ञाङ्गानि द्विजातिभिः ।
तथोपकरणं सर्वं मङ्गलानि च सर्वशः ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said: Whatever parts of the sacrifice the twice-born have prescribed for this rite, and all the implements and auspicious items,

verses.text:
अधियज्ञांश्च संभारान्धौम्योक्तान्क्षिप्रमेव हि ।
समानयन्तु पुरुषा यथायोगं यथाक्रमम् ॥

meaning.en: and the materials for the sacrifice stated by Dhaumya, let men quickly bring all of them, each properly and in order.

verses.text:
इन्द्रसेनो विशोकश्च पूरुश्चार्जुनसारथिः ।
अन्नाद्याहरणे युक्ताः सन्तु मत्प्रियकाम्यया ॥

meaning.en: Let Indrasena, Vishoka and Puru, Arjuna's charioteer, be put in charge of fetching food and the like, to please me.

verses.text:
सर्वकामाश्च कार्यन्तां रसगन्धसमन्विताः ।
मनोहराः प्रीतिकरा द्विजानां कुरुसत्तम ॥

meaning.en: Let all desirable things be provided, rich in flavour and fragrance, delightful and pleasing to the brahmins, best of the Kurus.

verses.text:
तद्वाक्यसमकालं तु कृतं सर्वमवेदयत् ।
सहदेवो युधां श्रेष्ठो धर्मराजे महात्मनि ॥

meaning.en: As soon as he spoke, Sahadeva, best of warriors, reported to the great-souled king of dharma that everything had been done.

verses.text:
ततो द्वैपायनो राजन्नृत्विजः समुपानयत् ।
वेदानिव महाभागान्साक्षान्मूर्तिमतो द्विजान् ॥

meaning.en: Then Dvaipayana, O king, brought the priests, great and blessed brahmins who seemed the Vedas themselves in bodily form.

verses.text:
स्वयं ब्रह्मत्वमकरोत्तस्य सत्यवतीसुतः ।
धनंजयानामृषभः सुसामा सामगोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Satyavati's son himself took the role of Brahma priest for him; Susaman, bull of the Dhananjayas, became the Sama chanter.

verses.text:
याज्ञवल्क्यो बभूवाथ ब्रह्मिष्ठोऽध्वर्युसत्तमः ।
पैलो होता वसोः पुत्रो धौम्येन सहितोऽभवत् ॥

meaning.en: Yajnavalkya, supreme among knowers of Brahman, became the chief Adhvaryu; Paila, son of Vasu, became the Hotri, together with Dhaumya.

verses.text:
एतेषां शिष्यवर्गाश्च पुत्राश्च भरतर्षभ ।
बभूवुर्होत्रगाः सर्वे वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः ॥

meaning.en: Their disciples and sons, bull of the Bharatas, all became assistants of the Hotri, masters of the Vedas and their limbs.

verses.text:
ते वाचयित्वा पुण्याहमीहयित्वा च तं विधिम् ।
शास्त्रोक्तं योजयामासुस्तद्देवयजनं महत् ॥

meaning.en: Having recited the auspicious blessing and arranged the rite, they laid out that great sacrificial ground as the scriptures direct.

verses.text:
तत्र चक्रुरनुज्ञाताः शरणान्युत शिल्पिनः ।
रत्नवन्ति विशालानि वेश्मानीव दिवौकसाम् ॥

meaning.en: With their leave, the craftsmen there built lodgings, large, jewelled houses like the dwellings of the gods.

verses.text:
तत आज्ञापयामास स राजा राजसत्तमः ।
सहदेवं तदा सद्यो मन्त्रिणं कुरुसत्तमः ॥

meaning.en: Then that best of kings, the best of the Kurus, at once commanded his minister Sahadeva:

verses.text:
आमन्त्रणार्थं दूतांस्त्वं प्रेषयस्वाशुगान्द्रुतम् ।
उपश्रुत्य वचो राज्ञः स दूतान्प्राहिणोत्तदा ॥

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said: Send swift messengers at once to invite people. Hearing the king's word, Sahadeva then sent messengers:

verses.text:
आमन्त्रयध्वं राष्ट्रेषु ब्राह्मणान्भूमिपानपि ।
विशश्च मान्याञ्शूद्रांश्च सर्वानानयतेति च ॥

meaning.en: Sahadeva said: Invite the brahmins and kings in the realms, and the respected Vaishyas and Shudras; bring them all.

verses.text:
ते सर्वान्पृथिवीपालान्पाण्डवेयस्य शासनात् ।
आमन्त्रयां बभूवुश्च प्रेषयामास चापरान् ॥

meaning.en: They, at the Pandava's command, invited all the kings of the earth, and sent out others besides.

verses.text:
ततस्ते तु यथाकालं कुन्तीपुत्रं युधिष्ठिरम् ।
दीक्षयां चक्रिरे विप्रा राजसूयाय भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then at the proper time the brahmins consecrated Yudhishthira, son of Kunti, for the Rajasuya, O Bharata.

verses.text:
दीक्षितः स तु धर्मात्मा धर्मराजो युधिष्ठिरः ।
जगाम यज्ञायतनं वृतो विप्रैः सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: Consecrated, righteous Yudhishthira, king of dharma, went to the sacrificial ground surrounded by thousands of brahmins,

verses.text:
भ्रातृभिर्ज्ञातिभिश्चैव सुहृद्भिः सचिवैस्तथा ।
क्षत्रियैश्च मनुष्येन्द्र नानादेशसमागतैः ।
अमात्यैश्च नृपश्रेष्ठो धर्मो विग्रहवानिव ॥

meaning.en: with his brothers, kinsmen, friends and ministers, and Kshatriyas come from many lands, lord of men; the best of kings, with his counsellors, seemed Dharma embodied.

verses.text:
आजग्मुर्ब्राह्मणास्तत्र विषयेभ्यस्ततस्ततः ।
सर्वविद्यासु निष्णाता वेदवेदाङ्गपारगाः ॥

meaning.en: Brahmins came there from various countries, accomplished in every science, masters of the Vedas and their limbs.

verses.text:
तेषामावसथांश्चक्रुर्धर्मराजस्य शासनात् ।
बह्वन्नाञ्शयनैर्युक्तान्सगणानां पृथक्पृथक् ।
सर्वर्तुगुणसंपन्नाञ्शिल्पिनोऽथ सहस्रशः ॥

meaning.en: At the king's command, thousands of craftsmen built lodgings for them, each group separately, well supplied with food and beds, and suited to every season.

verses.text:
तेषु ते न्यवसन्राजन्ब्राह्मणा भृशसत्कृताः ।
कथयन्तः कथा बह्वीः पश्यन्तो नटनर्तकान् ॥

meaning.en: In these the brahmins lived, greatly honoured, telling many tales and watching actors and dancers.

verses.text:
भुञ्जतां चैव विप्राणां वदतां च महास्वनः ।
अनिशं श्रूयते स्मात्र मुदितानां महात्मनाम् ॥

meaning.en: The loud noise of the brahmins eating and talking, and of those great-souled men rejoicing, was heard incessantly.

verses.text:
दीयतां दीयतामेषां भुज्यतां भुज्यतामिति ।
एवंप्रकाराः संजल्पाः श्रूयन्ते स्मात्र नित्यशः ॥

meaning.en: Such talk was heard there daily: Give to them, give! Eat, eat!

verses.text:
गवां शतसहस्राणि शयनानां च भारत ।
रुक्मस्य योषितां चैव धर्मराजः पृथग्ददौ ॥

meaning.en: The king of dharma gave away, separately, hundreds of thousands of cows, beds, gold and women, O Bharata.

verses.text:
प्रावर्ततैवं यज्ञः स पाण्डवस्य महात्मनः ।
पृथिव्यामेकवीरस्य शक्रस्येव त्रिविष्टपे ॥

meaning.en: So the sacrifice of the great-souled Pandava, the sole hero on earth, went forward like Shakra's in heaven.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा प्रेषयामास पाण्डवम् ।
नकुलं हास्तिनपुरं भीष्माय भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira sent the Pandava Nakula to Hastinapura, bull of the Bharatas, to Bhishma,

verses.text:
द्रोणाय धृतराष्ट्राय विदुराय कृपाय च ।
भ्रातॄणां चैव सर्वेषां येऽनुरक्ता युधिष्ठिरे ॥

meaning.en: to Drona, Dhritarashtra, Vidura and Kripa, and to all his brothers who were devoted to Yudhishthira.
